ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Delivery, Steady state and later stages need Health and Next review date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Onboarding", 1, "Kickoff done", 2, "First deliverables", 3, "Steady state", 4, "At risk", 5, "Wrapping up", 6, "Completed", 7, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Health__c)), ISBLANK(Next_review_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Health and Next review date before moving to Steady state.
